title: .guided-plugins.json
description: Project settings read by the Guided Plugins skills and by scripts/guided-review-ci.mjs. Every key is optional. See docs/PROJECT_CONFIG.md.

primary.description: The book that decides when books disagree, for example clean-code.

secondary.description: Books applied for the decisions they cover; they defer to the primary book.

strictness.description: relaxed reports blockers and majors only; normal adds minors; strict adds nits.

ignore.description: Globs of files not to review or edit. Like .gitignore: a pattern without a slash matches at any depth, a trailing slash means a folder.

maxFindings.description: At most this many findings in a report; the report says how many were left out.

failOn.description: For CI (guided-review-ci.mjs and the GitHub Action): fail when a finding at this level or above remains. The pre-push hook does not read it; it uses GUIDED_FAIL_ON.
